implementation_summary:
read-page.ts exports readPage(page, { responseHeaders?, maxTextChars? }), ReadPageOptions, ReadPageResult and READ_PAGE_MAX_TEXT_CHARS (100000). One page.evaluate of a self-contained readDom function walks document.body in DOM order. Hidden subtrees (display:none) add no text but are still walked for facts; visibility:hidden text is skipped. Block-level elements and
end a text chunk; whitespace is collapsed to single spaces, other characters are kept as they are. Section boundaries: header/nav/main/aside/footer (also by role) are landmarks only when they are not inside another landmark other than main. header/footer inside article/aside/main/nav/section do not count. An h1/h2 (or role=heading level 2 or less) outside non-main landmarks also starts a Section. A boundary with nothing in it yet is replaced by the next one, so main followed straight by its h1 gives a 'heading' Section. An element at a pending boundary creates an empty boundary chunk. Headings, anchors and CTAs are recorded after their own text, so they land in the chunk that holds it. When a landmark nested in main ends, the next text goes back to a 'main' Section. Link region is checked in this order: breadcrumb (aria-label/class contains breadcrumb, case-insensitive, or itemtype BreadcrumbList), then menu (nav, header, role navigation or banner), then footer (footer, role contentinfo), else internal. The menu tree comes from the header's nav (else the first nav that is not a breadcrumb and not in the footer), with nested ul/ol under each li. The breadcrumb trail is read from the leaf li items, then from itemListElement, then from anchors plus [aria-current]. Form fields keep type, label, name and required only. Values are never read: textarea and select content are skipped, and submit/button inputs read only their value attribute as the button label. Head facts use the SEO collectDetails selectors, copied: title (null when there is no title element), meta description, html lang. Also read: meta generator, script[src], link rel~=stylesheet, iframe[src], JSON-LD @types at any depth (raw copy cut at JSON_LD_RAW_CAP), og:/twitter: keys, framework markers and
innerText. Text collection stops once maxTextChars is reached, and buildPageContent cuts it exactly. responseHeaders are lower-cased, and set-cookie, set-cookie2, cookie, authorization and proxy-authorization are dropped. The origin passed to buildPageContent is new URL(page.url()).origin. The SEO checker is unchanged.

tests_proposed: Unit fixture for nested landmarks (aside inside main resumes 'main'; article header not a landmark) and role=region pages
Microdata BreadcrumbList without li, and a page with no landmarks (single 'page' Section)
evidence: packages/core/tests/audit-read-page.test.ts: read() helper calls site.clearRequests() then readPage and asserts site.requests.length === 0, no page 'request' events and an unchanged page.url()
risks: vitest.workspace.ts does not yet list 'audit-read-page' in BROWSER_TESTS.core (group G7 owns that file), so the test currently runs in the 'unit' project although it launches Chromium.

readPage passes a named function (readDom) to page.evaluate. Playwright sends its source text to the browser, so if the build or transform ever turns on esbuild keepNames, injected __name helpers would break it. It works today under tsc and vitest.
readPage should be called after the page has settled (load/networkidle). Text written by script after the read is missed. The test waits for networkidle.
Hidden (display:none) subtrees still add anchors, images and headings, the same way SEO collectDetails counts them, but add no text and no CTA candidates.
Links in header-tools (language switch, Sign in) and the logo link count as 'menu' because they sit inside <header>, as the region rule requires.
page.evaluate errors (page closed, navigation during the read) are passed on to the caller; the crawl must catch them.
handoff: G2 crawl: call readPage(page, { responseHeaders, maxTextChars }) while each recorded page is still open, after it has settled. It makes no request and does not navigate. Pass the response headers as received; credential headers are dropped inside readPage, but the crawl should still avoid sending them. G7: add 'audit-read-page' to BROWSER_TESTS.core in vitest.workspace.ts. BE-306 (analysis barrel) should export readPage, ReadPageOptions, ReadPageResult and READ_PAGE_MAX_TEXT_CHARS. framework marker names emitted: __NEXT_DATA__, __next, ng-version, astro-island, data-wf-site, __nuxt, data-v-app, data-server-rendered, ___gatsby, data-reactroot (BE-303 should match these strings). Image src is the src attribute as written (currentSrc only when there is no src).
